import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientCanonical
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientOver
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientFiniteAtlasOver
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientFree

/-!
# Finite quotients of varieties

This is the scheme formulation of Milne I.8.10. A variety has a geometrically
reduced, separated structure morphism of finite type. The source orbit
hypothesis only concerns closed points; the constructed quotient satisfies
the geometric quotient conditions on the full scheme topology and all opens.

The finite invariant-ring atlas supplies existence and the variety properties.
The invariant structure sheaf supplies uniqueness, including compatibility
with the base field. Freeness on rational points gives an etale projection.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

open StableAffineOpen

variable {k G : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Group G] [Finite G]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} (act : G →* Aut X) (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))

/-- A finite group acting on a variety with affine neighborhoods of its
closed-point orbits has a finite geometric quotient variety. The quotient
is unique over the base field and is etale when the action is free on
rational points. No quotient or factorization datum is assumed. -/
theorem exists_finite_geometricQuotient
    [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p] [IsSeparated p]
    [GeometricallyReduced p]
    (hact : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ p = p)
    (horbit : ∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X) →
      ∃ U : X.affineOpens, ∀ g : G, (act g).hom.base x ∈ U.1) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (q : X ⟶ Y),
      q ≫ pY = p ∧
      LocallyOfFiniteType pY ∧ QuasiCompact pY ∧ IsSeparated pY ∧
      GeometricallyReduced pY ∧ IsFinite q ∧ Surjective q ∧
      IsGeometricQuotient act q ∧
      ((∀ (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ X), x ≫ p = 𝟙 _ →
          ∀ g : G, x ≫ (act g).hom = x → g = 1) → Etale q) ∧
      (∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (pZ : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (q' : X ⟶ Z),
        q' ≫ pZ = p → IsGeometricQuotient act q' →
          ∃! e : Y ≅ Z, q ≫ e.hom = q' ∧ e.hom ≫ pZ = pY) := by
  letI : X.IsSeparated :=
    (HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @IsSeparated) (f := p)).mp inferInstance
  letI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace p
  letI : JacobsonSpace X := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace p
  let h := orbitsInAffineOpen_of_closedPoints act horbit
  let q := finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection act p hact h
  let pY := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData act p hact h).map
    (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum act p hact h)
  have hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q :=
    finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient act p hact h
  have hqbase : q ≫ pY = p :=
    finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjectionOver_comp_base act p hact h
  refine ⟨_, pY, q, hqbase, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_locallyOfFiniteType act p hact h
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_quasiCompact act p hact h
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_isSeparated act p hact h
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_geometricallyReduced act p hact h
  · exact finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isFinite act p hact h
  · exact ⟨finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_surjective act p hact h⟩
  · exact finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_etale_of_rational_points act p hact h
  · intro Z pZ q' hq'base hq'
    exact hq.existsUnique_iso_over hq' hqbase hq'base

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
